saints.name: All Saints
saints.shortBiography: The whole company of saints is celebrated, from the apostles to those known only to God. Their lives remind us that every faithful witness contributes to the glory of the Church.
saints.antiphon: All Saints, pray for us, that we may follow Christ in holiness.
saints.intercession: God of mercy, through the witness of All Saints, strengthen your people in faithful service.
saints.concludingPrayer: Lord God, you called All Saints to bear witness to the Gospel; grant us the grace to imitate that holy example. Through Christ our Lord.
